summary: Evidence Manager is Partially Mocked. Simulation does not load from CSV; relies on 10 hardcoded sliders. Promote only works for those 10.

findings.finding: Hardcoded list of 10 keys in initialize_slider_state.
p_game constructor hardcodes 10 parameters from session state.
Reads CSV for display but not for model input.

recommendation: Use ParamsJax.from_yaml or EvidenceRegistry to bootstrap params; use session state overrides for ALL fields dynamically.
